research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Flow Neuroscience is engaged in developing a headset for transcranial direct-current stimulation, as described in 'Headset for transcranial direct-current stimulation, tdcs, and a system,' which details a forehead frame with electrodes for brain stimulation. Additionally, 'Positioning of electrodes for transcranial brain stimulation' outlines a method using cameras to guide accurate electrode placement on the user's head. These efforts focus on non-invasive brain stimulation device design and precise application techniques.

press_references.value: How a New Device Treats Depression With Electroshock Therapy

product_launches.description: Flow Neuroscience is highlighted for offering a new electroshock-based device intended to treat depression, presenting a modern spin on an established therapy.
Flow Neuroscience received FDA 510(k) clearance for at-home use of its Flow brain-stimulation device for treatment of major depressive disorder, as monotherapy or adjunctive therapy.

overview_description.description:
Flow Neuroscience is a healthcare company that develops depression treatment devices that combines an easy-to-use brain stimulation headset with a personalized mobile app to target both the physical and behavioral elements of Major Depressive Disorder (MDD). The company's wearable stimulates a patient's left frontal lobe, the area of the brain that has often lowered activity in people suffering from depression.

Flow Neuroscience combines their wearable with a mobile app that nudges users to behaviors that will help lessen the effects of their depression, including exercise and regular sleeping patterns.

The company's hope is to make available for the public a treatment that's currently only used in clinics specialized in brain stimulation. It also wants to make the treatment affordable enough to seriously challenge a dominant pharmaceuticals industry.

about_short_description.short_description: Flow Neuroscience is a healthcare company that develops direct current stimulation device and behavioral therapy app for depression.

product.name: Flow tDCS Headset
product.description: A home-use medical device that delivers transcranial direct current stimulation to brain regions associated with mood regulation as part of depression treatment.

product.name: Flow Treatment Program
product.description: An app-guided depression treatment program combining headset-based tDCS sessions, behavioral therapy exercises, symptom tracking, and treatment guidance for home use.

product.name: Flow Replacement Pads
product.description: Replacement electrode pad sets used with the Flow tDCS Headset to conduct stimulation through the forehead during treatment sessions.

product.name: Flow for Healthcare Providers
product.description: A provider-facing service that supports clinical access, prescription, deployment, and monitoring of Flow-based depression treatment in clinics and healthcare systems.
